consular.mission: Australian Consulate, Dar es Salaam; Australian High Commission, Nairobi
consular.notes: The Australian Consulate in Dar es Salaam provides limited consular help to Australians in Tanzania by appointment only. The consulate doesn't issue passports. Full consular help is available from the Australian High Commission in Kenya.
